race.comment: WOOTTEN HYDE (7) is the horse to beat after returning with a bang here three weeks ago over this trip first-up. His form around some smart ones adds some substance and with Thompson sticking he can repeat the dose. BOSS MODE (9) was a smart winner when resuming at Doomben and has been good in his next two without striking. Suspect he's at his top now and Maloney can give him a great look from the good draw. CONCESSION (5) was better second-up without threatening at the Gold Coast over this trip. Has further improvement in store third-up and gets in well at the weights with the 3kg claimer taking over. In the mix. TEN TRINITY SQUARE (6) returns from a 704 day break and makes his stable debut for the Clark-peoples camp. The lightly raced 7YO was unbeaten through three at Toowoomba back in 2024 before coming to town and only falling a lip shy to Pocket Full. Suspect he will need a run or two before he's back to his best but there's talent there.
